title: Diagnostic Review: Tabular Feature Engineering & Leakage Isolation
description: Review a tabular feature engineering and validation preprocessing pipeline for global scaling leakage, in-fold target leakage, and future lookahead features.

artifact.content:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

def prepare_modeling_features(df: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    # Step 1: Preprocessing and feature normalization
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    df["scaled_experience_years"] = scaler.fit_transform(df[["experience_years"]])
    
    # Step 2: Target encoding on high-cardinality categorical feature
    employer_target_mean = df.groupby("employer_name")["annual_compensation_inr"].transform("mean")
    df["employer_mean_pay"] = employer_target_mean
    
    # Step 3: Event horizon calculations
    df["months_to_next_promotion"] = (df["next_promotion_date"] - df["offer_date"]).dt.days / 30.4
    
    # Step 4: Chronological train/test split
    train_df = df[df["offer_date"] < "2026-01-01"].copy()
    test_df = df[df["offer_date"] >= "2026-01-01"].copy()
    
    return train_df, test_df

defects.title: Global Feature Normalization Across Train and Test Partitions
defects.consequence: Fitting the scaler on the entire dataset prior to splitting leaks empirical distribution parameters (mean and variance) from future test sets into training features.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Fit transformers strictly on the train partition and apply transform() to test partitions.

defects.title: Unguarded In-Fold Target Encoding with Self-Target Leakage
defects.consequence: Calculating group target averages without out-of-fold leave-one-out cross-fitting causes extreme target leakage and severe overfitting.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Use out-of-fold leave-one-out target encoding with smoothing or fit target statistics strictly inside training folds.

defects.title: Forward-Looking Future Promotion Horizon Used as Feature
defects.consequence: Using an event occurring after the offer date introduces severe lookahead bias that will not exist at real-time inference.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Restrict predictive features strictly to covariates available at the time of estimation.

instructions: Review the Python feature engineering pipeline for data leakage, forward-looking features, and improper cross-validation boundaries. Flag flawed line numbers and categorize each defect.
